Executive summary

In nine months, Marie turned an AI mandate into a firm-wide Human-AI transformation engine – proving that AI scales through people, not tools.

The answer first: Marie led AI as a people, workflow and operating-model transformation – with one central team, integrated in all services, multiplied through a firm-wide ecosystem. It now drives adoption across a ~15,000-people firm, its clients and peer organizations in 10+ countries.
